verdict: McDonald's revenue was flat at $6.5B as global comparable sales fell 1.0% in every segment — and $154M of impairment and restructuring charges pulled operating income down 6% to $2.9B.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: flat vs a year ago; +1% in constant currencies

segments.name: Franchised restaurants
segments.note: Rent and royalties paid by the local owners who run most McDonald's restaurants — the heart of the business model.

segments.name: Company-owned restaurants
segments.note: Food and drink sold at restaurants McDonald's runs itself.

segments.name: Other revenues
segments.note: Fees and other income beyond rent, royalties and restaurant sales.

segmentNote: Comparable sales fell in every segment: U.S. -0.7% on fewer guests despite higher average checks, International Operated Markets -1.1% (led by France), and International Developmental Licensed Markets -1.3% on the continued impact of the war in the Middle East and weak demand in China. Systemwide sales to loyalty members were about $7B in the quarter.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Head office, marketing support and running the global franchising machine — $691M of SG&A (including $101M of depreciation and amortization), plus $107M of other operating expense, net, which includes the impairment charges detailed below.

otherDetail: Interest expense of $373M on McDonald's debt, partly offset by $9M of net nonoperating income.
footerNote: The release's rounded lines imply pre-tax income of $2,556M against the $2,555M printed; the $1M rounding difference is carried in the tax line (printed provision: $533M) so this page ties exactly to reported net income of $2,022M.

takeaways.title: Comparable sales fell everywhere
takeaways.text: Global comparable sales fell 1.0%: the U.S. slipped 0.7% on fewer guest visits despite higher average checks, International Operated Markets fell 1.1% led by France, and Developmental Licensed Markets fell 1.3% on the war in the Middle East and soft demand in China.

takeaways.title: Revenue held flat
takeaways.text: Total revenue was flat at $6,490M (+1% in constant currencies): franchised rent and royalties held steady at $3,940M while company-run restaurant sales slipped 1% to $2,461M, with new restaurants offsetting weaker sales at existing ones.

takeaways.title: Charges trimmed EPS
takeaways.text: Operating income fell 6% to $2,920M after $154M of pre-tax charges — $97M of impairments, mainly for the planned sale of the South Korea business, plus $57M of 'Accelerating the Organization' restructuring. Excluding charges, EPS was $2.97 versus the reported $2.80.

oneTimers: Pre-tax non-cash impairment charges of $97M, primarily related to the anticipated future sale of McDonald's business in South Korea.
Pre-tax restructuring charges of $57M for 'Accelerating the Organization,' the company's internal modernization program. Together the charges cost $0.17 of EPS; excluding them, EPS was $2.97.
